items.title: Terry McLaurin: Seemingly game-time decision for Week 5
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring), who officially is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest against the Giants, will be a game-time decision, as Jeremy Fowler of ESPN highlighted Friday in a Week 5 injury update on SportsCenter.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Will Shipley: Philly's top RB for Week 5
items.text:
Shipley is slated to lead the Eagles backfield against the Jaguars in Week 5 due to the absences of both Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Tank Bigsby (abdomen, IR), Chris McPherson of the Eagles' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: Remains sidelined Friday
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) remained a non-participant in Friday's practice for the Bills.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Will be RB1 again for Week 5
items.text:
Allen will once again operate as the Jets' top running back for Sunday's game against the Browns due to the absence of Breece Hall (quadriceps).

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Could have expanded role vs. Las Vegas
items.text:
Henderson will operate as the Patriots' RB1 if Rhamondre Stevenson (knee, questionable) is unable to play against the Raiders on Sunday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Set to play Sunday
items.text:
Love (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest versus the Lions, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
